CHECK BURST CS-assets-far_low — cut, register and catalogue the isolated objects of crop 'far_low' as reusable assets; build a T3l/T3m props package for this crop (Matt R-C3-61/62/68/73/79). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-assets-far_low".

Inputs (read-only): isolated sheets (sheet_1 → /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-objiso-far_low-1/objiso_far_low_1.png, sheet_2 → /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-objiso-far_low-2/objiso_far_low_2.png), all on #00ff00; layout /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-objsheets-far_low/layout.json (per sheet: tiles with id, crop_box in crop px, sheet_xy, sheet_size, scale); BEFORE /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-dress-canvases/dress_far_low_canvas.png; AFTER /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-dress-far_low/dress_far_low.png; crop origin in level px /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-dress-canvases/dress_far_low.json (origin_px). Frozen /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py extract(edge_mode='clamp') for the key. The props.json contract = SPEC § 7 rows T3l and T3m in /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md (read those rows only). python glue PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files.

STEP 1 — per tile: cut sheet_xy+sheet_size, clamp-matte → RGBA, resize by 1/scale (premultiplied LANCZOS) to the crop_box size.
STEP 2 — REGISTRATION: integer shift search ±10 px minimising mean |RGB| vs AFTER over alpha ≥ 200 pixels; report shift + residual; flag |shift| > 3 or residual > 22; apply the shift.
STEP 3 — SPLIT: connected groups of alpha ≥ 32 (3-px grouping dilation); drop groups touching the tile border (spill from neighbours) and groups < 250 px; each remaining group is one asset named far_low_<tile id>_<letter a,b,…> (left to right).
STEP 4 — SHADOW (one sprite for the crop): R = luminance(AFTER)/luminance(BEFORE), both 11-px Gaussian blurred; s = clip(1 − R, 0, 0.7); s = 0 where s < 0.05 or where BEFORE is #00ff00; soften 2 px. Save out/props/shadow_far_low.png as black RGB with alpha = s.
STEP 5 — PACKAGE: out/props/assets/<name>.png (tight RGBA, 2-px pad); out/props/props.json with assets [{name, file 'assets/<name>.png', anchor = [x-centroid of the bottom 6 opaque rows, lowest opaque row + 1] in asset px, footprint {w: 60, h: 40} (placeholder; the conductor derives shaped footprints), collide true, fade_when_behind = true iff the asset's opaque height > 200 px}], instances [{asset, position = origin + crop position of the anchor}], shadows [{file 'shadow_far_low.png', position = origin, opacity 1.0}], overhead [], near [], particles []. Validate with export.props_layer's own loader (import read-only from the burst repo; report its verdict).
STEP 6 — out/rebuild_vs_after.png (BEFORE × (1 − s) + assets over by anchor y | AFTER | |diff|×3, 768×512 each); out/asset_sheet.png (every asset over mid-grey at 1× with name and size); out/catalogue.json (per asset: name, size_px, anchor, level_position, registration, provenance); out/summary.txt ≤ 12 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 14 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-assets-far_low"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
